topic.source_contract: Public and private drinking-water quality, supply-zone and regulatory evidence

facts.guard: national regulatory-sample compliance is not a property result or network-capacity guarantee
zone and national totals are not exact connection, pressure or sufficiency evidence
a legal standard is not a candidate sample result
implementation guidance is not supplier compliance or property clearance

facts.private_supply: local-authority risk assessment at least every five years where required
facts.guard: private-supply risk assessment and public-supply monitoring are distinct

scope_guards: National drinking-water compliance is not a property-level sample or future guarantee.
Water supply zones are monitoring and reporting geographies, not HMLR parcels or exact service boundaries.
Compliance, water quality, supply sufficiency, pressure and connection capacity remain distinct.
Public water supplies and private water supplies have different regulatory and evidence routes.
A legal standard or company report is not evidence that a candidate tap meets the standard.
Reported events, audits and compliance failures require company, zone, date and parameter matching.
A private-supply risk assessment does not replace sampling, remedial action or planning and abstraction evidence.
No score or promotion is written without exact supplier or private source, zone, sampling, events, connection, sufficiency and planning evidence.
